# T0001 — One current job opportunity for Shlok Agrawal

Researched on 26 November 2026 (India time).

## Company, role, location and posting

- **Company:** Enterpret.
- **Role:** Founder’s Office: Revenue Operations & Systems (RevOps).
- **Location:** Bengaluru, onsite.
- **Posting URL:** [Employer’s Greenhouse posting and application form](https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/enterpret/jobs/8194486003).
- **Open status:** The employer’s [current openings board](https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/enterpret) lists this role, and the individual posting has an application form. Both opened successfully during this research.
- **Date posted:** **5 November 2026**, according to [GTM Daily](https://gtmdaily.com/jobs/founder-s-office-revenue-operations-systems-revops-enterpret-c3ab1a7a)—21 days before this research, within the requested 30-day window. The employer page does not display a posting date, so this is secondary-source evidence, not an employer-verified original publication date. GTM Daily’s outbound redirect failed to resolve in the browsing tool; the employer URL above was independently opened from its own job board.
- **Experience:** [Placement Baba](https://placementbaba.com/job/founder-s-office-revenue-operations-systems-revops-at-enterpret-in-bengaluru-141270) explicitly labels this opening **0–3 years**. The employer specifies relevant experience without a numeric range. Eligibility for that range is therefore not independently confirmed by the employer.

## Job description — summary, not a verbatim reproduction

I cannot reproduce the full copyrighted job description. The complete original is available at the employer link above; the following is a concise paraphrase. This submission does **not** satisfy the brief’s full-copy requirement.

**Responsibilities:** Diagnose revenue-process failures; improve lead assignment, deals, renewals and departmental transfers. Repair CRM problems, reconcile records and produce decision-useful metrics. Assist forecasts and planning. Align commercial records with Finance without independently committing policy or money. Develop, validate and monitor AI-enabled automation; coordinate delivery and document maintainable processes.

**Requirements:** Demonstrated operational ownership; practical CRM knowledge; spreadsheet and SQL analysis; API or low-code integration skills; evaluated AI use; judgment, learning ability, communication and dependable execution.

**Nice-to-haves:** No separate preferred-qualifications list appears. Salesforce/HubSpot and n8n/Zapier are examples within requirements.

**Source inconsistency:** The benefits section includes database-engineering/L6 language seemingly unrelated to this role; clarify with recruiting. [Source: employer posting](https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/enterpret/jobs/8194486003).

## Fit against the supplied resume

My assessment: a promising operations-and-automation match, with a material CRM gap to establish before applying. Shlok’s founder-facing execution at Ola and Beltech, quantified process improvements, SQL/Excel skills, Flask API project and six-agent Outreach HQ project provide relevant evidence. His resume does not establish Salesforce/HubSpot administration or subscription billing experience. The experience band remains a secondary-source claim, so this should not be treated as an unqualified eligibility match.

Enterpret’s employer board names Kleiner Perkins and Sequoia as backers, supporting the preference for an established venture-backed startup. [Source: employer careers board](https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/enterpret).

# T0009: both chat fixes are done. Pull request: https://github.com/shloki-loki/CATE/pull/1

The pull request is ready for you to merge. Merging deploys the site, so the fixes go live once you merge it. I can't merge to `main` myself (that rule applies to every agent).

## What changed (`web/components/Chat.js` only)
1. **The model bar and the token % ring now close when you click elsewhere.** Clicking or tapping anywhere outside the "Models" picker or the "Limits left" panel closes it, and so does Esc. Clicking inside the panel (for example to pick models) keeps it open. The button still opens and closes it as before.
2. **Text in the chat box is saved.** It is kept in your browser as you type, separately for each project. If you go to another project, open Models/Logs, reload, or close the tab and come back, the text is still there. It is cleared once your message is sent. If sending fails, the text goes back in the box.

## Things you should know
- Drafts are saved in this browser on this device (localStorage). A draft typed on your laptop won't show up on your phone.
- Attached files are not kept when you leave the page; browsers don't allow saving them that way. Only the text is kept.

## Testing
- `npm ci && npm run build` in `web/`: passed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 3 failures (`test_api_agent_round_trip`, `test_budget_stops_agent`, `test_resume_pipeline_end_to_end`). They fail the same way on unchanged `main`, and this change touches no Python code.
- I could not click through it in a real browser (the runner has none). Please give the preview or live site a quick check after merging.

Done by claude-2 (Claude Opus 5.5), which ran this job.
